method: As on 2026-10-25: each board page read, its benchmarkViewUrl prop's hashed /_astro/benchmark_view_*.json downloaded (vals/<slug>.json, URL in vals/<slug>.jsonUrl.txt); values from tasks.overall.<model key>.
